import json
from rest_api import RestAPI

def j(x): return json.loads(x)

# 1. Multiple IOUs accumulate, reverse-direction netting
api = RestAPI({"users": []})
for n in ("Adam", "Bob", "Chuck", "Dan"):
    api.post("/add", json.dumps({"user": n}))
api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Adam", "borrower": "Bob", "amount": 12.0}))
api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Chuck", "borrower": "Adam", "amount": 4.0}))
api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Dan", "borrower": "Adam", "amount": 9.5}))
api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Bob", "borrower": "Adam", "amount": 6.5}))
api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Dan", "borrower": "Adam", "amount": 2.75}))
users = j(api.get("/users"))
print("ALL:", json.dumps(users))
adam = [u for u in users["users"] if u["name"] == "Adam"][0]
assert adam["owes"] == {"Bob": 5.5, "Chuck": 4.0, "Dan": 12.25}, adam
assert adam["owed_by"] == {}, adam
assert abs(adam["balance"] - (-21.75)) < 1e-9, adam

# 2. Filtered query sorted by name
res = j(api.get("/users", json.dumps({"users": ["Dan", "Bob"]})))
assert [u["name"] for u in res["users"]] == ["Bob", "Dan"], res
assert all(set(u) == {"name", "owes", "owed_by", "balance"} for u in res["users"])

# 3. Netting: borrower already owes lender -> amounts add & are sorted
d = {"users": [{"name": "Adam", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {"Bob": 2.0}, "balance": 2.0},
               {"name": "Bob", "owes": {"Adam": 2.0}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": -2.0}]}
api = RestAPI(d)
r = j(api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Adam", "borrower": "Bob", "amount": 5.25})))
assert r["users"][0]["name"] == "Adam"
assert r["users"][0]["owed_by"] == {"Bob": 7.25}, r
assert r["users"][1]["owes"] == {"Adam": 7.25}, r
assert r["users"][0]["balance"] == 7.25 and r["users"][1]["balance"] == -7.25

# 4. Exact payoff clears both sides, reverse partial, decimals
d = {"users": [{"name": "Adam", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {"Bob": 3.33}, "balance": 3.33},
               {"name": "Bob", "owes": {"Adam": 3.33}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": -3.33}]}
api = RestAPI(d)
r = j(api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Bob", "borrower": "Adam", "amount": 3.33})))
assert r["users"][0]["owed_by"] == {} and r["users"][0]["owes"] == {}, r
assert r["users"][1]["owes"] == {} and r["users"][1]["owed_by"] == {}, r
assert r["users"][0]["balance"] == 0.0 and r["users"][1]["balance"] == 0.0

# 5. Self-consistent state after a chain from lender-owes-borrower reversal
d = {"users": [{"name": "Adam", "owes": {"Bob": 3.0}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": -3.0},
               {"name": "Bob", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {"Adam": 3.0}, "balance": 3.0}]}
api = RestAPI(d)
api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Adam", "borrower": "Bob", "amount": 4.0}))
s = {u["name"]: u for u in j(api.get("/users"))["users"]}
assert s["Adam"]["owed_by"] == {"Bob": 1.0} and s["Adam"]["owes"] == {}, s
assert s["Bob"]["owes"] == {"Adam": 1.0} and s["Bob"]["owed_by"] == {}, s
print("EDGE CASES OK")
